lease.root_owned_surfaces: public routes, manifests, agent registries, migration, generated authority, claims, acceptance, and release are forbidden
lease.external_effects: locked and offline local tests in isolated /private/tmp roots only

required_behavior: Every parsed global, repository, built-in, and generated descriptor is read-only before it can affect verification or eligibility.
Layer classification cannot bypass sandbox enforcement.
Write-capable global authority returns the stable SandboxPolicyRejected class and cannot produce eligibility.
Existing exact global allowlist, unexpected-row reporting, source-role effects, and zero-write behavior remain intact.
required_validation: case, symlink, special-file, substitution, TOCTOU, unknown, ambiguous, and route false-pass controls
focused suite twice, dependency agent routes, production library check, zero-write proof, authoritative receipt parser, exact artifact set, and mutation controls with 16 jobs and threads
stop_rule: Stop on any path expansion, public or host mutation, unstable error class, loss of unexpected-global reporting, or inability to prove no eligibility after rejection.
no_claim_statement: This work package does not claim source acceptance, route eligibility, live-host or fresh-session behavior, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
